result.description:
Primary metric evaluation results organized by source and result identifiers.

Structure: `map<sourceId, map<resultKey, Timeseries>>`
- Outer map key: ID of the source object on which metrics were evaluated
- Inner map key: Result identifier for each metric, which can be either:
  1. The original metric name from the expression (default behavior)
  2. A custom key generated by {@link EvalMetricsSpec#resultKey} lambda function

When accessing specific metrics (e.g., via {@link #timeseries}), use the inner map key
as the identifier. This key may differ from the original metric name when
{@link EvalMetricsSpec#resultKey} is specified in the evaluation specification.

@see EvalMetricsSpec#resultKey
@see #timeseries
@see #byMetrics

evalPlan.description:
Detailed evaluation plan containing execution metadata and performance analysis.

Populated when {@link EvalMetricsSpec#explain} is set to true in the evaluation specification.
Contains information about expression parsing, metric resolution, execution timing, and
optimization details. Useful for debugging performance issues and understanding metric
evaluation behavior.

@see EvalMetricsSpec#explain
@see EvalPlan

errors.description:
Error information for failed metric evaluations by source object.

Structure: sourceId -> error message
Populated only when {@link EvalMetricsSpec#continueOnError} is set to true, allowing
evaluation to continue despite failures for specific source/metric combinations.
Sources with successful evaluations will not appear in this map.

@see EvalMetricsSpec#continueOnError

translations.description:
Localized display labels for metrics organized by result key.

Structure: `map<resultKey, translatedLabel>`
Populated when {@link EvalMetricsSpec#locale} is specified in the evaluation
specification. Maps the same keys used in {@link #result} to their translated,
human-readable labels in the requested locale.

Note: The keys in this map correspond to the inner map keys from {@link #result},
which may be customized by {@link EvalMetricsSpec#resultKey}, not necessarily
the original metric names.

@see EvalMetricsSpec#locale
@see EvalMetricsSpec#resultKey
@see Translation

title:
Results from metric evaluation operations in the C3 AI Agentic Platform.

In the C3 AI Agentic Platform, EvalMetricsResult contains the output from evaluating metrics
using {@link MetricEvaluatable#evalMetrics} or {@link MetricEvaluatable#evalMetricsWithMetadata}.
Provides structured access to {@link Timeseries} data, evaluation plans, error information,
and utilities for data transformation and visualization.

Key Use Cases:
1. Metric Analysis: Access computed metric values across multiple sources and time periods
2. Data Visualization: Transform results for charts and dashboards using built-in renderers
3. Error Handling: Track evaluation failures when using continueOnError option
4. Performance Monitoring: Analyze evaluation plans and execution timing details
5. Data Export: Convert results to various formats (DataTable, pandas DataFrame)

Result Structure:
- Primary data organized as: sourceId -> resultKey -> {@link Timeseries}
- Alternative view available via {@link #byMetrics}: resultKey -> sourceId -> {@link Timeseries}
- Error tracking per source when evaluation failures occur
- Optional evaluation plan for performance analysis and debugging

IMPORTANT: Result Key Customization
The inner map key in {@link #result} serves as the identifier for each evaluated metric.
By default, this key is the metric name from the expression. However, when
{@link EvalMetricsSpec#resultKey} is specified in the evaluation specification,
this custom lambda function generates the result keys, allowing for dynamic key naming based
on expression names, bindings, and other evaluation context.

Integration Patterns:
- Triggered by {@link MetricEvaluatable} implementations on entity Types
- Consumed by UI components for metric dashboards and analytics
- Processed by data pipelines for metric aggregation and reporting
- Used with {@link EvalMetricsSpec} for configuring evaluation parameters

Performance Characteristics:
- Optimized for read access to metric data across multiple sources
- Supports efficient data flattening and transformation operations
- Memory-efficient storage of large metric result sets
- Built-in caching support through evaluation specifications

Related Types:
- {@link EvalMetricsSpec} - Configuration for metric evaluation operations
- {@link MetricEvaluatable} - Interface for Types that support metric evaluation
- {@link Timeseries} - Individual metric value sequences with temporal data
- {@link EvalPlan} - Execution plan details for performance analysis

@see EvalMetricsSpec
@see MetricEvaluatable
@see Timeseries
@see EvalPlan
@see metrics-evaluating-metrics.c3doc.md
@see metrics-bindings.c3doc.md
@see metrics-home.c3doc.md
